title: Aivu, son of Rav
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Pesachim 113a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.113a.6). His father said to him, “I see that you are not succeeding in your studies. Come, I will teach you worldly matters,” and taught him the ways of commerce.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rav addresses Aivu as his son and gives him commercial advice.
[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=387&lang=en) quotes Rav’s opening and his advice about selling promptly. Hyman gives the exchange in paraphrase.
